parametric-arc-length.def: The length of the curve $x = x(t)$, $y = y(t)$ for $a \le t \le b$ is $L = \int_a^b \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2}\,dt$, provided the curve is traced exactly once as $t$ runs from $a$ to $b$. The integrand is the speed of the moving point, so the same integral gives the distance it travels, even when it retraces part of the curve.
